parse_audio_segment: parse an audio segment string into an Audio or AudioBytes object with start and end frames
load_audio_tensor: load an audio file from disk and return a resampled 1d torch tensor at the target sampling rate
compute_audio_overlap: compute the overlap fraction or IOU between two Audio segments using the IntersectMethods enum
split_mining_line: split a tab-separated mining line into a MiningLineResult with score, source, and target parsed fields
auto_parse_annotation: auto parse an annotation string into a float, Text, Audio, or AudioBytes object by trying each format
